name: Rosendahl (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rosendahl (a white bend with three roses on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Münster of 25 January 1980 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner; the flag is red, white and red striped horizontally 1:3:1 with the municipal arms in the middle of the white stripe.

features.role: Rosendahl arms — bend with roses on red
